points.title: 出生地
points.description: 冼星海出生于澳门的一个渔民家庭，他的童年生活在海边度过，这段经历对他后来的音乐创作产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Xian Xinghai was born in a fisherman's family in Macau. His childhood spent by the sea had a profound impact on his later musical compositions.

points.title: 艺术启蒙
points.description: 冼星海在上海开始了他的艺术生涯，他在这里接触到了西方音乐，并开始创作自己的音乐作品。他的第一首交响曲《民族解放交响曲》在这里首演。
points.descriptionEn: Xian Xinghai began his artistic career in Shanghai, where he was exposed to Western music and started composing his own works. His first symphony, 'Symphony of National Liberation,' premiered here.

points.title: 留学深造
points.description: 冼星海在法国留学，深入研究音乐理论，并创作了多部作品。他在巴黎音乐学院学习期间，创作了《黄河大合唱》，这是他的代表作之一。
points.descriptionEn: Xian Xinghai studied music theory in France and composed several works during his time there. While studying at the Paris Conservatory, he composed 'The Yellow River Cantata,' one of his masterpieces.

points.title: 音乐创作与革命活动
points.description: 冼星海回到中国后，积极参与革命活动，并在音乐创作上取得了巨大成就。他的作品在抗日战争中发挥了重要作用，激励了无数中国人民。他在1945年因肺结核去世。
points.descriptionEn: Upon returning to China, Xian Xinghai actively participated in revolutionary activities and achieved significant success in music composition. His works played a crucial role in the Anti-Japanese War, inspiring countless Chinese people. He died of tuberculosis in 1945.

supporter.zh: 冼星海被誉为中国现代音乐的奠基人之一，他的音乐作品具有强烈的爱国主义情感，对后世产生了深远的影响。
supporter.en: Xian Xinghai is hailed as one of the founders of modern Chinese music, with his works imbued with strong patriotic sentiment, which have had a profound impact on future generations.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，冼星海的音乐作品过于政治化，缺乏艺术性，且在音乐理论上的贡献有限。
critic.en: Some critics argue that Xian Xinghai's musical works were too politicized, lacking in artistic merit, and his contributions to music theory were limited.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，冼星海被视为中国现代音乐的重要代表，他的音乐作品在抗日战争期间发挥了鼓舞人心的作用，但他的音乐风格和理论贡献也受到争议。
objective.en: In the academic community, Xian Xinghai is regarded as an important representative of modern Chinese music, whose works played an inspirational role during the Anti-Japanese War. However, his musical style and theoretical contributions are also subject to controversy.

self.zh: 音乐是人生最大的快乐。
self.en: Music is the greatest happiness in life.

others.zh: 冼星海的音乐是中华民族的精神象征。
others.en: Xian Xinghai's music is a symbol of the spirit of the Chinese nation.
